IHrmPlatformActivityLog.IRequest.x-autobe-specification: Query parameters for filtering and paginating hrm_platform_activity_logs. Maps: actionType → action_type (exact match), userId → member_id (UUID exact match), targetEntityType → target_entity_type (exact match), dateFrom → created_at >= value, dateTo → created_at <= value. Pagination: page (1-based, default 1), limit (1-100, default 20). All fields optional. Backend enforces organization_id from JWT context - never user-provided. Results sorted by created_at DESC.

startDate.description: Start date of the reporting period (inclusive). ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD). Defines the beginning of the date range for weekly aggregation.
startDate.x-autobe-specification: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) defining the inclusive start boundary of the reporting period. Backend filters hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE work_date >= startDate. Used to determine the first week to include in aggregation.

endDate.description: End date of the reporting period (inclusive). ISO 8601 date format (YYYY-MM-DD). Defines the end of the date range for weekly aggregation.
endDate.x-autobe-specification: ISO date string (YYYY-MM-DD) defining the inclusive end boundary of the reporting period. Backend filters hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE work_date <= endDate. Used to determine the last week to include in aggregation.

projectCode.description: Optional project code filter. When provided, limits results to timelogs associated with the specified project. Uses project code (not UUID) for human-readable filtering.
projectCode.x-autobe-specification: Optional project code string for filtering results to a specific project. Backend looks up project_id from hrm_platform_projects WHERE code = projectCode, then filters timelogs WHERE project_id = matched_id. If omitted, includes all projects in the organization.

page.description: Page number for pagination (1-indexed). Minimum value is 1. Determines which page of weekly summary results to retrieve.
page.x-autobe-specification: 1-indexed page number for pagination. Backend calculates OFFSET = (page - 1) * limit. Minimum value is 1. Defaults to 1 if not provided. Controls which page of weekly results to return.

limit.description: Maximum number of weekly summaries per page. Must be between 1 and 100. Controls the page size for paginated results.
limit.x-autobe-specification: Number of records per page. Backend uses as LIMIT clause. Constrained between 1 and 100. Controls the maximum number of weekly summaries returned in one response.

IHrmPlatformWeeklySummaryReport.IRequest.description: Request parameters for querying weekly time tracking summary reports. Specifies the date range for aggregation, optional project filter, and pagination controls for retrieving paginated weekly statistics.
IHrmPlatformWeeklySummaryReport.IRequest.x-autobe-specification: Query parameters for weekly summary report endpoint. Filters hrm_platform_timelogs by: (1) date range using startDate/endDate inclusive boundaries, (2) optional project_id via projectCode lookup in hrm_platform_projects. Aggregates timelogs by week (Monday 00:00 to Sunday 23:59 in organization timezone). Computes: totalHours = SUM(duration_minutes)/60, timelogCount = COUNT(*), employeeCount = COUNT(DISTINCT employee_id). Joins hrm_platform_employees for employee context, filters by member's current organization_id. Pagination via page/limit applies to weekly result set. Results sorted by weekStart descending. Requires report:view permission.

personal.description: Personal time tracking metrics including hours logged today and this week, active timer status, recent timelog entries, current timesheet status, and tasks assigned to the user.
personal.x-autobe-specification: Aggregates personal time tracking data: (1) SUM duration_minutes from hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE employee_id = current AND date = CURRENT_DATE for hoursToday. (2) SUM duration_minutes WHERE employee_id = current AND date BETWEEN week_start AND week_end for hoursThisWeek. (3) SELECT * FROM hrm_platform_timers WHERE employee_id = current AND deleted_at IS NULL for activeTimer. (4) SELECT * FROM hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE employee_id = current ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 5 for recentTimelogs. (5) SELECT status FROM hrm_platform_timesheets WHERE employee_id = current AND week_start = current_week_start for timesheetStatus. (6) SELECT * FROM hrm_platform_tasks WHERE assignee_id = current AND status IN ('open', 'in-progress') for assignedTasks. All queries use current employee_id from JWT session.

organization.description: Organization-wide analytics including active employee count, total hours logged this week, pending timesheets awaiting approval, projects with high budget utilization, and top performers by hours logged. Null if user lacks report:view permission.
organization.x-autobe-specification: Aggregates organization-wide analytics (only if user has report:view permission, otherwise returns null): (1) COUNT FROM hrm_platform_employees WHERE organization_id = current AND status = 'active' for activeEmployeeCount. (2) SUM duration_minutes FROM hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE organization_id = current AND date BETWEEN week_start AND week_end for totalWeeklyHours. (3) COUNT FROM hrm_platform_timesheets WHERE organization_id = current AND status = 'submitted' for pendingTimesheetsCount. (4) SELECT projects WHERE budget_hours IS NOT NULL AND (SUM(timelogs.duration_minutes) / budget_hours * 100) > 80 for highBudgetUtilizationProjects. (5) SELECT employee_id, SUM(duration_minutes) FROM hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE organization_id = current GROUP BY employee_id ORDER BY SUM DESC LIMIT 5 for topPerformers. All queries filtered by organization_id from user's current context.

IHrmPlatformDashboard.description: Dashboard response containing personalized time tracking metrics and activity overview. For employees: displays hours logged today and this week, active timer status if running, five most recent timelog entries, current week's timesheet submission status, and tasks assigned to the user. For users with report:view permission: additionally includes organization-wide analytics such as active employee count, total weekly hours logged, pending timesheet count, projects with high budget utilization, and top performers by hours logged.
IHrmPlatformDashboard.x-autobe-specification: Computed dashboard type aggregating multiple sources. Personal section: Query hrm_platform_timelogs for today's (date = CURRENT_DATE) and weekly (week_start to week_end) duration_minutes sum. Query hrm_platform_timers where employee_id = current AND deleted_at = null for activeTimer. Query hrm_platform_timelogs ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 5 for recentTimelogs. Query hrm_platform_timesheets for current week status (draft/submitted/none). Query hrm_platform_tasks where assignee_id = current AND status IN ('open', 'in-progress') for assignedTasks. Organization section (report:view permission only): Count hrm_platform_employees WHERE status = 'active'. Sum hrm_platform_timelogs duration_minutes for organization this week. Count hrm_platform_timesheets WHERE status = 'submitted'. Query hrm_platform_projects WITH budget_hours, calculate (logged_hours / budget_hours * 100) > 80. Top 5 employees by weekly timelog duration. All queries filtered by organization_id from user context. Returns null for organization section if user lacks report:view permission.

group_type.description: The grouping dimension for this report entry. Indicates whether hours are aggregated by employee, project, or task.
group_type.x-autobe-specification: Query parameter value echoed in response. Determines which entity reference (employee/project/task) is populated. Values: 'employee', 'project', 'task'.

employee.description: Employee reference when grouped by employee. Null when grouped by project or task.
employee.x-autobe-specification: LEFT JOIN to hrm_platform_employees via timelogs.employee_id. Returns IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary when group_type='employee', otherwise null.

project.description: Project reference when grouped by project. Null when grouped by employee or task.
project.x-autobe-specification: LEFT JOIN to hrm_platform_projects via timelogs.project_id. Returns IHrmPlatformProject.ISummary when group_type='project', otherwise null.

task.description: Task reference when grouped by task. Null when grouped by employee or project.
task.x-autobe-specification: LEFT JOIN to hrm_platform_tasks via timelogs.task_id. Returns IHrmPlatformTask.ISummary when group_type='task', otherwise null.

total_hours.description: Total hours worked in this grouping dimension. Sum of billable and non-billable hours.
total_hours.x-autobe-specification: SUM(timelogs.duration_minutes) / 60.0. Rounded to 2 decimal places. Includes all timelogs in the group regardless of billable status.

billable_hours.description: Hours worked on billable tasks. Timelogs marked as billable only.
billable_hours.x-autobe-specification: SUM(timelogs.duration_minutes WHERE timelogs.billable = true) / 60.0. Rounded to 2 decimal places.

non_billable_hours.description: Hours worked on non-billable tasks. Timelogs marked as non-billable only.
non_billable_hours.x-autobe-specification: SUM(timelogs.duration_minutes WHERE timelogs.billable = false) / 60.0. Rounded to 2 decimal places.

IHrmPlatformTimeReport.ISummary.description: Time report summary showing aggregated hours for a single grouping dimension (employee, project, or task). Includes total hours worked with billable and non-billable breakdown. Used in paginated time report responses.
IHrmPlatformTimeReport.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation from hrm_platform_timelogs. JOIN to hrm_platform_employees, hrm_platform_projects, hrm_platform_tasks based on group_type. Calculations: total_hours = SUM(duration_minutes) / 60, billable_hours = SUM(duration_minutes WHERE billable=true) / 60, non_billable_hours = SUM(duration_minutes WHERE billable=false) / 60. group_type determines which entity reference (employee/project/task) is populated; others are null. Organization context applied via employee.organization_id filter.

weekStart.description: Start date of the week period (Monday at 00:00:00).
weekStart.x-autobe-specification: Computed: First day of the ISO week period (Monday 00:00:00). Derived by grouping timelog entries by ISO week and extracting the week start boundary. Format: ISO 8601 date-time.

weekEnd.description: End date of the week period (Sunday at 23:59:59).
weekEnd.x-autobe-specification: Computed: Last day of the ISO week period (Sunday 23:59:59). Derived by grouping timelog entries by ISO week and extracting the week end boundary. Format: ISO 8601 date-time.

totalHours.description: Total hours logged by all employees during the week period.
totalHours.x-autobe-specification: Computed: SUM(duration_minutes) / 60 from hrm_platform_timelogs for all entries within the week period. Result is a decimal number representing total hours logged.

timelogCount.description: Number of individual time entry records logged during the week period.
timelogCount.x-autobe-specification: Computed: COUNT(*) of hrm_platform_timelogs entries within the week period. Integer value representing the number of individual time entries.

employeeCount.description: Number of unique employees who logged time during the week period.
employeeCount.x-autobe-specification: Computed: COUNT(DISTINCT employee_id) from hrm_platform_timelogs JOIN hrm_platform_employees for entries within the week period. Integer value representing unique employees who logged time.

IHrmPlatformWeeklySummaryReport.ISummary.description: Weekly summary statistics for time tracking reports. Contains aggregated hours logged, timelog entry count, and unique employee count for a specific week period (Monday to Sunday). Used in organization-level time reports to show weekly activity trends.
IHrmPlatformWeeklySummaryReport.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation type derived from hrm_platform_timelogs JOIN hrm_platform_employees ON employee_id. Grouping: ISO week boundaries (Monday 00:00:00 to Sunday 23:59:59). Aggregations: totalHours = SUM(duration_minutes) / 60, timelogCount = COUNT(*), employeeCount = COUNT(DISTINCT employee_id). Filters: organization_id from authenticated member context, optional project_id from request, optional date range from request. Sort order: weekStart descending (most recent weeks first). Edge cases handled: weeks spanning year boundaries use ISO week calculation, weeks with zero timelogs are excluded from results.

id.description: Unique identifier for the member account.
id.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_members.id (UUID primary key).

display_name.description: Member's display name shown across all organizations.
display_name.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_members.display_name (string). User's display name shown across all organizations.

avatar_image.description: URL to member's avatar/profile image. Null if not uploaded.
avatar_image.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_members.avatar_image (nullable string, max 80000 chars). URL to user's avatar/profile image.

phone_number.description: Member's phone number for contact. Null if not provided.
phone_number.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_members.phone_number (nullable string). User's phone number for contact.

IHrmPlatformMember.ISummary.description: Lightweight member profile summary for display in lists and references. Contains essential identification fields: unique identifier, display name, optional avatar image URL, and optional phone number. Used across employee records, session tracking, invitations, task history, and activity logs to identify members without exposing sensitive account data.
IHrmPlatformMember.ISummary.x-autobe-specification: Direct mapping from hrm_platform_members table. Includes only essential display fields for lightweight member references: id (UUID), display_name (string), avatar_image (nullable string), phone_number (nullable string). Excludes sensitive fields (email, password_hash), system timestamps (created_at, updated_at, deleted_at), and all relations. Used as member reference in employee records, session tracking, invitations, task history, and activity log contexts.

hoursToday.description: Total hours logged today by the employee, calculated from timelog duration minutes.
hoursToday.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_platform_timelogs: SUM(duration_minutes) WHERE employee_id = current AND DATE(date) = CURRENT_DATE, divided by 60 to convert to decimal hours. Query uses employee_id from JWT session.

hoursThisWeek.description: Total hours logged this week (Monday to Sunday) by the employee, calculated from timelog duration minutes.
hoursThisWeek.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_platform_timelogs: SUM(duration_minutes) WHERE employee_id = current AND date BETWEEN week_start (Monday 00:00) AND week_end (Sunday 23:59) of current ISO week, divided by 60 to convert to decimal hours. Query uses employee_id from JWT session.

activeTimer.description: Currently running timer if active, null if no timer is running.
activeTimer.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_platform_timers: SELECT * WHERE employee_id = current AND deleted_at IS NULL. Returns IHrmPlatformTimer object if active timer exists, null otherwise. Each employee can have at most one active timer.

recentTimelogs.description: Five most recent timelog entries ordered by date descending.
recentTimelogs.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_platform_timelogs: SELECT * WHERE employee_id = current ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 5. Returns array of IHrmPlatformTimelog.ISummary objects. Query uses employee_id from JWT session.

assignedTasks.description: Tasks assigned to the employee with status 'open' or 'in-progress'.
assignedTasks.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_platform_tasks: SELECT * WHERE hrm_platform_employee_id = current AND status IN ('open', 'in-progress'). Returns array of IHrmPlatformTask.ISummary objects. Query uses employee_id from JWT session and organization_id from current context.

IHrmPlatformDashboard.IPersonal.description: Personal time tracking metrics and activity overview for the authenticated employee. Includes hours logged today and this week, active timer status if running, five most recent timelog entries, current week's timesheet submission status, and tasks assigned to the user.
IHrmPlatformDashboard.IPersonal.x-autobe-specification: Computed dashboard type aggregating multiple sources for the authenticated employee. hoursToday: SUM duration_minutes from hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE employee_id = current AND DATE(date) = CURRENT_DATE, converted to decimal hours (divide by 60). hoursThisWeek: SUM duration_minutes WHERE employee_id = current AND date BETWEEN week_start (Monday) AND week_end (Sunday) of current ISO week. activeTimer: SELECT from hrm_platform_timers WHERE employee_id = current AND deleted_at IS NULL, returns null if no active timer exists. recentTimelogs: SELECT from hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE employee_id = current ORDER BY date DESC LIMIT 5, returns array of ISummary objects. timesheetStatus: SELECT status from hrm_platform_timesheets WHERE employee_id = current AND week_start = current_week_start (Monday), returns 'none' if no timesheet exists for current week. assignedTasks: SELECT from hrm_platform_tasks WHERE assignee_id = current AND status IN ('open', 'in-progress'), returns array of ISummary objects. All queries use employee_id extracted from JWT session and organization_id from user's current context.

activeEmployeeCount.description: Number of active employees in the organization.
activeEmployeeCount.x-autobe-specification: COUNT FROM hrm_platform_employees WHERE organization_id = current AND status = 'active' AND deleted_at IS NULL.

totalWeeklyHours.description: Total hours logged across the organization this week (Monday to Sunday).
totalWeeklyHours.x-autobe-specification: SUM(duration_minutes) FROM hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE organization_id = current (via employee JOIN) AND date BETWEEN week_start (Monday) AND week_end (Sunday) AND deleted_at IS NULL, divided by 60 to convert to hours.

pendingTimesheetsCount.description: Number of timesheets awaiting approval (status: submitted).
pendingTimesheetsCount.x-autobe-specification: COUNT FROM hrm_platform_timesheets WHERE organization_id = current (via employee JOIN) AND status = 'submitted' AND deleted_at IS NULL.

highBudgetUtilizationProjects.x-autobe-specification: SELECT projects WHERE budget_hours IS NOT NULL AND (SUM(timelogs.duration_minutes)/60 / budget_hours * 100) > 80. Returns array of IHrmPlatformDashboard.IOrganizationProjectBudgetUtilization with project summary and utilization percentage.

topPerformers.description: Top 5 employees ranked by hours logged this week.
topPerformers.x-autobe-specification: SELECT TOP 5 employees ranked by SUM(timelogs.duration_minutes) for current week (Monday-Sunday), grouped by employee_id. Returns array of IHrmPlatformDashboard.IOrganizationTopPerformer with employee summary and total hours.

IHrmPlatformDashboard.IOrganization.description: Organization-wide analytics dashboard data visible to users with report:view permission. Includes active employee count, total hours logged across the organization this week, number of timesheets pending approval, projects with high budget utilization (over 80%), and top 5 performers ranked by hours logged this week.
IHrmPlatformDashboard.IOrganization.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation type for organization dashboard. activeEmployeeCount: COUNT FROM hrm_platform_employees WHERE organization_id = current AND status = 'active' AND deleted_at IS NULL. totalWeeklyHours: SUM(duration_minutes) FROM hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE organization_id = current (via employee JOIN) AND date BETWEEN week_start (Monday) AND week_end (Sunday) AND deleted_at IS NULL, divided by 60 for hours. pendingTimesheetsCount: COUNT FROM hrm_platform_timesheets WHERE organization_id = current (via employee JOIN) AND status = 'submitted' AND deleted_at IS NULL. highBudgetUtilizationProjects: SELECT projects WHERE budget_hours IS NOT NULL AND (SUM(timelogs.duration_minutes)/60 / budget_hours * 100) > 80, returns array of project summaries with utilization percentage. topPerformers: SELECT TOP 5 employees ranked by SUM(timelogs.duration_minutes) for current week (Monday-Sunday), grouped by employee_id, returns array of employee summaries with total hours. All queries filtered by organization_id from user's current session context.

employee.description: The employee who logged the hours, including their profile, role, department, and employment details.
employee.x-autobe-specification: JOIN hrm_platform_timelogs.employee_id → hrm_platform_employees.id. Returns IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary containing: id, user (JOIN to hrm_platform_members via user_id), role (JOIN to hrm_platform_roles via role_id), department (LEFT JOIN to hrm_platform_departments via department_id, nullable), position, employment_type, status, created_at. Filtered by organization_id from current session context.

totalHours.description: Total hours logged by this employee in the current week (Monday to Sunday), calculated from all timelog entries.
totalHours.x-autobe-specification: SUM(hrm_platform_timelogs.duration_minutes) WHERE timelog.employee_id matches employee AND timelog.work_date >= week_start (Monday 00:00 UTC) AND timelog.work_date <= week_end (Sunday 23:59 UTC) AND timelog.deleted_at IS NULL. Result divided by 60 to convert minutes to decimal hours. Returns number type (e.g., 40.5 hours).

IHrmPlatformDashboard.IOrganizationTopPe.description: Top performer entry for organization dashboard showing an employee and their total hours logged in the current week (Monday to Sunday). Used in the top 5 performers list ranked by hours logged this week.
IHrmPlatformDashboard.IOrganizationTopPe.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation type for dashboard top performers list. employee: JOIN hrm_platform_timelogs.employee_id → hrm_platform_employees.id, then JOIN hrm_platform_employees.user_id → hrm_platform_members.id and hrm_platform_employees.role_id → hrm_platform_roles.id and hrm_platform_employees.department_id → hrm_platform_departments.id. Returns IHrmPlatformEmployee.ISummary with user (ISummary), role (ISummary), department (ISummary nullable), position, employment_type, status. totalHours: SUM(hrm_platform_timelogs.duration_minutes) WHERE timelog.employee_id = current employee AND timelog.work_date BETWEEN week_start (Monday 00:00) AND week_end (Sunday 23:59) AND timelog.deleted_at IS NULL, divided by 60 to convert minutes to decimal hours. Query scoped by organization_id from user's current session context via employee.organization_id = current_organization. Results ranked by totalHours DESC, limited to top 5 performers.

project.description: Project summary information including id, name, color_code, status, and timeline details.
project.x-autobe-specification: Reference to IHrmPlatformProject.ISummary. The project object is fetched from hrm_platform_projects table via project.id JOIN.

budget_hours.description: Total estimated budget hours allocated for the project.
budget_hours.x-autobe-specification: Sourced from hrm_platform_projects.budget_hours via the project reference. Guaranteed NOT NULL for this DTO type since only projects with budget are included in the dashboard report.

actual_hours.description: Actual hours logged across all timelogs for this project by all employees.
actual_hours.x-autobe-specification: Computed from hrm_platform_timelogs: SUM(duration_minutes) WHERE project_id = current project AND deleted_at IS NULL, divided by 60 to convert minutes to hours. Aggregated across all employees in the organization.

utilization_percentage.description: Percentage of budget consumed, calculated as actual hours divided by budget hours multiplied by 100.
utilization_percentage.x-autobe-specification: Computed formula: (actual_hours / budget_hours) * 100, rounded to 2 decimal places. Represents the percentage of the project budget that has been consumed.

IHrmPlatformDashboard.IOrganizationProje.description: Project budget utilization information for dashboard display. Includes the project summary, budgeted hours, actual hours logged by all employees, and the percentage of budget consumed. Used to identify projects with high budget utilization (over 80%).
IHrmPlatformDashboard.IOrganizationProje.x-autobe-specification: Computed aggregation type for organization dashboard. project: $ref to IHrmPlatformProject.ISummary (fetched from hrm_platform_projects). budget_hours: sourced from hrm_platform_projects.budget_hours via the project reference (guaranteed NOT NULL for this type since only projects with budget are included). actual_hours: SUM(duration_minutes) FROM hrm_platform_timelogs WHERE project_id = current AND deleted_at IS NULL, divided by 60 to convert to hours. utilization_percentage: (actual_hours / budget_hours) * 100, rounded to 2 decimal places. Filtered by organization_id from user's current session context via project.organization_id JOIN.
